title: qboot: Converter from Conformal Bootstrap Equations to Semidefinite Programming
description:
qboot is a C++ library that converts conformal bootstrap equations into semidefinite programming problems. It supports sums of operators over both infinite and finite ranges of scaling dimensions.

The implementation and its applications are described in Mocho Go's doctoral thesis, An Automated Generation of Bootstrap Equations for Numerical Study of Critical Phenomena (arXiv:2006.04173).
